## Hosting

This website is hosted through [GitHub Pages](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/what-is-github-pages), a service provided by GitHub. When the website is accessed, GitHub may process technical information such as the visitor's IP address, the requested page, date and time of access, referring page, and browser or device information. GitHub states that visitors' IP addresses are logged and stored for security purposes.

The purpose of this processing is to provide the website securely and reliably. To the extent that I am responsible for this processing, the legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. The legitimate interest is the secure and stable operation of this website. GitHub may process data in the United States and other countries. Further information is available in the [GitHub Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).

## Email contact

If you contact me by email, I process the information you provide in order to respond to your enquiry. The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR or, where the communication concerns a prospective contractual relationship, Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. The information is deleted when it is no longer required, unless a legal obligation requires longer retention.

## Cookies and analytics

This website does not use analytics, advertising, profiling, or non-essential cookies. Local browser storage may be used only for functions requested by the visitor, such as website preferences or search.

## Your rights

Subject to the applicable legal requirements, you have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and objection. You may also lodge a complaint with a data-protection supervisory authority. The competent authority in North Rhine-Westphalia is the [State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information NRW](https://www.ldi.nrw.de/kontakt/ihre-beschwerde).
